QQQ_benchmark: Own-period, own-cost passive QQQ buy-and-hold, not the active QQQ strategy sleeve
annual_alpha: 252 times the fitted daily intercept, arithmetic, not CAGR and not compounded
inference: Retrospective fitted-history attribution only; no p-values, significance, causal skill or untouched-OOS claim
method: Sample OLS with intercept via centered covariance solve. Daily portfolio and passive factor returns each subtract the exact same saved daily cash return once.
reproduction_scope: Saved account attribution only; no account or market-price replay
